title: San Sebastian Basque Burnt Cheesecake
hookLine: Caramelized dark burnished top with a molten custard cheesecake center — zero crust needed.

steps.title: Silky Cream Cheese & Sugar
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat {cream_cheese} and {sugar_bc} until completely smooth with zero lumps.

steps.title: Emulsify Custard Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk in {eggs_bc} one at a time, then pour in {cream_bc} and sift {flour_bc}. Stir gently to avoid excess air bubbles.
steps.creatorSecret: Room-temperature cream cheese is the #1 secret to zero-lump Basque batter.

steps.title: Bake at 425°F for the Signature Burn
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into a crumpled parchment-lined 8-inch springform pan. Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 32 minutes until deeply bronzed on top and jiggly in the center.
steps.criticalTip: CRITICAL: Chill at least 4 hours before slicing for custard perfection, or serve slightly warm for molten spoonfuls.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 44 mins.

title: Biscoff Espresso Cloud Tiramisu
hookLine: Whipped mascarpone clouds layered with espresso-soaked biscuits & melted Biscoff drip.

items.name: Melted Biscoff cookie butter + cocoa dust

steps.title: Whip Cloud Cream to Soft Peaks
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip {mascarpone}, {heavy_cream}, and {powdered_t} together for 3 minutes until thick, pillowy peaks hold.

steps.title: Dip Ladyfingers (1 Second Each)
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip {ladyfingers} briefly in {espresso} and line an 8x8 dish in an even layer.
steps.creatorSecret: Never soak ladyfingers longer than 1 second per side or the base turns soggy.

steps.title: Swirl Biscoff & Chill
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread half the mascarpone cream, drizzle warm {biscoff}, repeat layers, and dust generously with dark cocoa powder.
steps.criticalTip: Dust cocoa right before serving so it stays velvety dry.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 15 mins.

title: Crispy Cinnamon Sugar Churros & Choc Dip
hookLine: Shattering ridged pastry ridges tossed warm in cinnamon sugar with glossy dark ganache.

steps.title: Boil Butter-Water & Stir Flour
steps.instructionTemplate: Simmer {water_ch} and {butter_ch}, remove from heat, stir in {flour_ch} vigorously until a smooth ball forms, cool 3 mins, then beat in {egg_ch}.

steps.title: Pipe Ridges & Crisp Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Pipe star-tip strips onto parchment. Air-fry at 380°F for 11 mins (or shallow-fry 3 mins) until crisp golden, then toss warm in {cinn_ch} and serve with {choc_ch}.
steps.creatorSecret: Use a large open star piping tip—deep ridges create the crunchiest edges.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 22 mins.

title: Crispy Pistachio Kunafa Cheese Roll
hookLine: Golden buttered kataifi rolled around stretchy mozzarella & drenched in blossom syrup.

steps.title: Wrap Stretchy Cheese in Kataifi
steps.instructionTemplate: Toss {kataifi_k} with {ghee_k}, lay flat strips, place sticks of {mozz_k} inside, and roll tightly into golden cylinders.

steps.title: Bake Until Amber & Pour Syrup
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake or air-fry at 390°F (200°C) for 18 minutes until crackling amber. Immediately pour cool {syrup_k} over hot rolls and scatter {pist_k}.
steps.criticalTip: Hot kunafa + cool syrup is the golden rule so the pastry stays glass-crisp!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 28 mins.

title: Shatter-Top Crème Brûlée
hookLine: Velvety Madagascar vanilla bean custard topped with a paper-thin caramelized sugar glass.

steps.title: Whisk Warm Cream Into Yolks
steps.instructionTemplate: Simmer {cream_cb} with {van_cb}. Whisk {yolks_cb} and {sugar_cb}, then slowly stream warm cream in while whisking continuously.

steps.title: Bake Gently & Chill
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into ramekins set in a hot water bath. Bake at 325°F (165°C) for 35 minutes until edges set with a slight center wobble. Chill 3 hours.

steps.title: Sprinkle Sugar & Torch Until Glassy
steps.instructionTemplate: Sprinkle 1 tbsp sugar per ramekin and torch (or broil 2 mins) until bubbling amber. Wait 60 seconds for the iconic spoon crack!
steps.creatorSecret: Rest 60 seconds after torching so the sugar hardens into an ASMR glass sheet.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 45 mins.

title: 3-Ingredient Brazilian Brigadeiro Truffles
hookLine: Fudgy, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate caramel truffles made with just 3 pantry staples.

steps.title: Cook Fudge Until Pan-Pull Stage
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {cond_milk}, {cocoa_br}, and {butter_br} in a nonstick saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring constantly for 9–10 minutes until the mixture parts cleanly when you tilt the pan.
steps.creatorSecret: Do not rush on high heat—medium-low prevents scorching and builds shiny caramel chew.

steps.title: Roll Into Glossy Truffles
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour onto a buttered plate, chill 20 mins, then roll into bite-sized balls with lightly buttered hands and coat in chocolate sprinkles.
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 15 mins.

title: Jiggly Japanese Cotton Cheesecake
hookLine: Ultra-airy soufflé cheesecake that wobbles like a cloud and melts instantly on the tongue.

steps.title: Warm Cream Cheese Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently melt {cc_jp} and {milk_jp} over warm water. Whisk in egg yolks and sifted {flour_jp} until satin smooth.

steps.title: Whip Egg Whites to Soft Peaks
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip egg whites from {eggs_jp} with {sugar_jp} until glossy soft-curved peaks form, then fold gently in thirds into the batter.

steps.title: Bake in Water Bath for Cloud Rise
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in a parchment-lined pan set in hot water at 300°F (150°C) for 55 minutes. Leave oven door cracked 10 mins to prevent deflation!
steps.criticalTip: Cracking the oven door for 10 mins prevents sudden temperature drop collapse.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 70 mins.

title: Korean Strawberry Milk Bingsu
hookLine: Fluffy frozen condensed-milk snow grated with a fork—no shaved-ice machine required.

items.name: Mini mochi bites or cheesecake cubes

steps.title: Freeze Milk Flat & Fork-Fluff
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze {milk_bg} in a zip bag flat for 3 hours (or grate frozen milk cubes with a microplane/fork into fluffy snow).

steps.title: Top with Berries & Mochi
steps.instructionTemplate: Pile snowy flakes into a chilled bowl and top with {straw_bg}, {mochi_bg}, and an extra condensed-milk swirl.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill your serving bowl in the freezer for 10 minutes first so the snow stays airy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 10 mins.

title: 3-Milk Cloud Tres Leches Cake
hookLine: Featherlight sponge soaked in three milks and crowned with vanilla bean chantilly cream.

steps.title: Whip Airy Sponge & Bake 25m
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat egg yolks + half of {sugar_tl}, fold in whipped egg whites and {flour_tl}. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Pour 3-Milk Blend Over Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Poke holes all over cooled sponge with a fork and slowly pour {milks_tl} until fully absorbed. Chill 2 hours.

steps.title: Frost with Chantilly & Cinnamon
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread fluffy {whip_tl} across the top and dust lightly with cinnamon.
steps.creatorSecret: Using separated whipped egg whites makes the sponge drink up all three milks without collapsing.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 40 mins.

title: Matcha White-Choc Custard Taiyaki
hookLine: Crisp golden waffle-pressed taiyaki stuffed with ceremonial matcha cream & melted white choc.

steps.title: Mix Smooth Waffle Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {flour_ty} and {milk_ty} into a glossy pourable batter.

steps.title: Fill Center & Press Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour half batter into preheated taiyaki/waffle iron, spoon {matcha_ty} in center, cover with remaining batter, and press 4–5 minutes until crisp.
steps.creatorSecret: Wait 60 seconds after opening the press so the exterior crisps up nicely.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 14 mins.

title: Espresso Gelato Cookie Affogato
hookLine: Hot double espresso poured directly over frozen fior di latte gelato & a crisp cookie rim.

steps.title: Pour Hot Espresso Over Frozen Scoops
steps.instructionTemplate: Place {gelato_af} into chilled glasses, scatter {biscoff_af}, and pour steaming {esp_af} straight over top to create instant caramelized espresso foam.
steps.creatorSecret: Freeze your serving glasses 15 mins ahead so the gelato forms a delicious iced espresso shell.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 3 mins.

title: 10-Min Air Fryer S'mores Lava Dip
hookLine: Toasted campfire marshmallows bubbling over molten milk chocolate ganache in 10 mins.

steps.title: Melt Chocolate & Toast Marshmallows
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour {choc_sm} into a mini oven-safe skillet, pack {marsh_sm} tightly on top, and air-fry at 360°F (180°C) for 6–7 minutes until toasted golden brown. Scoop with {graham_sm}!
steps.creatorSecret: Add 2 tbsp heavy cream under the chocolate chips so the dip stays scoopable for 20+ minutes.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 10 mins.

title: 60-Second Molten Lava Chocolate Cake
hookLine: Crisp dark chocolate cake exterior that erupts with warm liquid ganache on the first forkful.

steps.title: Whisk Glossy Lava Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {dark_lv} until glossy. Whisk {eggs_lv} and {sugar_lv} pale, then fold in chocolate and {flour_lv}.

steps.title: Bake 11 Mins & Flip Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 11 minutes until sides are firm and centers still soft. Rest 1 minute, invert onto plates, and break open!
steps.criticalTip: Set a strict 11-minute timer—1 extra minute turns the molten core into regular cake!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 17 mins.

title: Thai Coconut Mango Sticky Rice Parfait
hookLine: Warm salted coconut sweet rice layered with velvety ripe honey mangoes & toasted sesame.

steps.title: Steam Sweet Rice Tender
steps.instructionTemplate: Rinse and steam {rice_mr} for 18 minutes until translucent and chewy.

steps.title: Fold Warm Salted Coconut Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour warm {coco_mr} with a pinch of sea salt over hot rice, cover 10 mins to absorb, and plate with {mango_mr} and extra salted coconut cream.
steps.creatorSecret: A generous pinch of sea salt in the coconut topping makes the mango taste twice as sweet.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 28 mins.

title: No-Bake Salted Caramel Banoffee Pie
hookLine: Buttery Biscoff biscuit crust, thick dulce de leche caramel, fresh bananas & clouds of cream.

items.name: Crushed digestive or Biscoff + 5 tbsp butter

steps.title: Press & Chill Biscuit Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Press {crumb_bn} firmly into a 9-inch tart pan and chill 15 minutes until firm.

steps.title: Spread Dulce de Leche, Bananas & Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Spread {dulce_bn} over chilled crust, layer {banana_bn}, pipe {cream_bn} high, and shave dark chocolate on top.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 15 mins.

title: Brown-Butter Toffee Chocolate Chip Cookies
hookLine: Nutty browned butter, pools of dark chocolate shards, crisp edges & gooey caramel centers.

items.name: Chopped dark chocolate + flaky sea salt

steps.title: Toast Butter Until Amber & Nutty
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {butter_cc} over medium heat swirling 4 mins until golden brown specks form and it smells like toasted hazelnuts. Cool 5 mins.
steps.creatorSecret: Keep swirling! Milk solids go from golden nutty to burnt in 15 seconds.

steps.title: Fold Chocolate & Bake 11 Mins
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {sugars_cc} and {egg_cc} into butter, fold in {flour_cc} and {choc_cc}. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 11 minutes, tapping the tray once at minute 9 for bakery ripples.
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 23 mins.

title: Cardamom Saffron Rasmalai Milk Cake
hookLine: Pillowy sponge soaked in fragrant saffron-cardamom milk and crowned with crushed pistachios.

steps.title: Bake Tender Cardamom Sponge
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake {sponge_rm} at 350°F (175°C) for 20 minutes until golden and springy.

steps.title: Steep Saffron Milk & Pour Over Cake
steps.instructionTemplate: Warm {milk_rm} with {saff_rm} for 5 mins, poke holes in the warm sponge, pour saffron milk over, chill 2 hours, and garnish with whipped cream & {pist_rm}.
steps.creatorSecret: Soak saffron in 2 tbsp warm milk first to unlock maximum golden color and aroma.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 35 mins.

title: Warm Honey Cardamom Gulab Jamun
hookLine: Golden milk-solid dumplings steeped in fragrant rosewater-cardamom syrup (amazing with vanilla ice cream).

steps.title: Roll Crack-Free Milk Spheres
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix {mpow_gj} and {ghee_gj} into a soft dough. Rest 5 mins, then roll into smooth crack-free marbles.

steps.title: Fry Golden & Steep in Warm Syrup
steps.instructionTemplate: Fry gently over low heat until deep golden brown, then transfer straight into warm {syrup_gj} for 20 minutes to plump up.
steps.creatorSecret: Frying slowly on low heat cooks the center evenly without burning the outside.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 27 mins.

title: French Macaron Dark Ganache Shells
hookLine: Smooth glossy almond meringue shells with ruffled feet and velvety dark chocolate ganache.

items.name: Superfine blanched almond flour + powdered sugar
Room-temp egg whites + 1/3 cup caster sugar

steps.title: Fold Until Ribbon Lava Consistency
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip {whites_mc} to stiff glossy peaks, then fold in sifted {almond_mc} until batter flows off the spatula like thick molten ribbon.

steps.title: Rest 30m Until Dry & Bake
steps.instructionTemplate: Pipe 1.5-inch rounds, tap tray to pop bubbles, rest 30 mins until dry to the touch, then bake at 300°F (150°C) for 14 mins. Sandwich with {ganache_mc}!
steps.criticalTip: Don't skip resting until a dry skin forms—that's what creates classic macaron feet.
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 39 mins.

title: Crispy Honey Pistachio Baklava Bites
hookLine: 40 paper-thin buttered phyllo layers packed with spiced pistachios & lemon-honey syrup.

items.name: Thawed phyllo pastry sheets + 3/4 cup butter

steps.title: Stack Buttered Phyllo & Nuts
steps.instructionTemplate: Layer brushed {phyllo_bk} sheets with spiced {nuts_bk} in thirds, then score diamonds before baking.

steps.title: Bake Golden & Pour Cold Syrup
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 mins until golden crisp. Pour cold {honey_bk} immediately over hot baklava so it crackles.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 45 mins.

title: Portuguese Pastel de Nata Custard Tarts
hookLine: Shattering puff pastry spirals cradling silky lemon-cinnamon vanilla custard with caramelized blisters.

items.name: Whole milk + 4 egg yolks + 1/2 cup sugar + 2 tbsp cornstarch

steps.title: Roll Puff & Press Muffin Cups
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll {puff_pn} into a tight log, slice 12 rounds, and press swirls up the sides of a muffin tin.

steps.title: Simmer Custard & Bake at 475°F
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {custard_pn} infused with {cinn_pn} until thick, fill pastry cups, and bake at 475°F (245°C) for 13–14 mins until blistered.
steps.creatorSecret: High oven heat creates the authentic caramelized blister spots without drying the custard.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 26 mins.

title: Fluffy Japanese Soufflé Jiggly Pancakes
hookLine: Sky-high cloud pancakes steamed gently in a covered skillet with whipped maple butter.

items.name: Granulated sugar + 1/4 tsp cream of tartar

steps.title: Fold Airy Egg Whites Gently
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk egg yolks with {flour_sp}. Whip whites from {eggs_sp} with {sugar_sp} to stiff glossy peaks and fold gently.

steps.title: Cook Covered Low Heat 5m/Side
steps.instructionTemplate: Mound batter tall onto a lightly oiled nonstick pan on lowest heat, add 1 tbsp water to pan edge, cover, and steam 5 mins per side.
steps.creatorSecret: Adding 1 tbsp water before covering generates gentle steam for maximum height.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 20 mins.

title: Strawberry Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta
hookLine: Silky 4-ingredient cream pudding with a velvety wobble & fresh macerated strawberry coulis.

items.name: Unflavored gelatin powder (bloomed in 2 tbsp water)

steps.title: Dissolve Gelatin in Warm Vanilla Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat {cream_pc} and {sugar_pc} until steaming (not boiling), remove from heat, and whisk in bloomed {gel_pc} until crystal clear.

steps.title: Chill 3 Hours & Spoon Berry Coulis
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into glasses, chill 3 hours until gently jiggly, and top with {berry_pc}.
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 8 mins.

title: Red Velvet Cream Cheese Swirl Cake
hookLine: Buttermilk cocoa velvet crumb crowned with tangy whipped cream cheese frosting.

items.name: Whipped cream cheese + butter + powdered sugar frosting

steps.title: Mix Velvet Batter & Bake 28m
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {bmilk_rv} and fold into {flour_rv} with 1 cup sugar and red food gel. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 28 minutes.

steps.title: Swirl Cream Cheese Frosting
steps.instructionTemplate: Once cool, generously swirl {frost_rv} over every layer.
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 43 mins.

title: French Mille-Feuille Napoleon Pastry
hookLine: Caramelized crisp puff pastry slabs stacked with silky vanilla diplomat pastry cream.

items.name: All-butter puff pastry sheets (dusted with icing sugar)
Vanilla pastry cream folded with whipped cream

steps.title: Bake Puff Under Second Tray
steps.instructionTemplate: Prick {puff_mf} with a fork, dust with icing sugar, cover with parchment + a second baking sheet to keep flat, and bake at 400°F (205°C) for 20 mins.
steps.creatorSecret: Weighting the pastry between two trays keeps the layers thin, even, and extra shattering.

steps.title: Pipe Cream Between Crisp Slabs
steps.instructionTemplate: Slice into rectangles and pipe neat pearls of {cream_mf} between three crisp layers.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 35 mins.

title: Crispy Pistachio Ricotta Cannoli Dip
hookLine: All the flavor of Sicilian cannoli in a 5-minute no-bake whipped ricotta dip with waffle chips.

items.name: Mascarpone or cream cheese + 1/2 cup powdered sugar

steps.title: Whip Ricotta Smooth & Fold Chips
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip {ricotta_cn} and {mascar_cn} with a pinch of cinnamon until fluffy. Fold in {chips_cn} and serve immediately with broken waffle cones!
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 8 mins.

title: Dark Chocolate Espresso Éclairs
hookLine: Hollow crisp choux shells piped full of vanilla crème pâtissière and dipped in mirror dark glaze.

steps.title: Bake Choux Logs 25m Until Crisp
steps.instructionTemplate: Pipe 5-inch logs of {choux_ec} and bake at 400°F (205°C) for 25 mins until deep golden and hollow.

steps.title: Pipe Cream Inside & Dip in Glaze
steps.instructionTemplate: Poke two holes underneath, pipe full of {pastry_ec}, and dip tops into glossy {glaze_ec}.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 45 mins.

title: Caramel Rum Bananas Foster Skillet
hookLine: Caramelized brown-butter bananas bubbling in cinnamon sauce over cold vanilla bean ice cream.

steps.title: Sizzle Bananas in Brown Butter Caramel
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {bsug_bf} in a wide skillet until bubbling caramel, lay {ban_bf} cut-side down 2 mins per side until glossy, and spoon hot over {ice_bf}.
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 11 mins.

title: Strawberry Crunch Ice Cream Sandwiches
hookLine: Soft chocolate wafer or cookie rounds stuffed with no-churn strawberry cheesecake ice cream.

items.name: Soft chocolate chip or Oreo cookies
Strawberry or vanilla bean ice cream

steps.title: Sandwich Ice Cream & Roll in Crunch
steps.instructionTemplate: Scoop softened {ice_is} between pairs of {cookies_is}, roll exposed edges in {crunch_is}, and freeze 45 mins to set firm.
steps.creatorSecret: Pre-chill your serving bowls or glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes for instant cafe presentation.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 12 mins.

title: Belgian Liege Pearl-Sugar Waffles
hookLine: Rich brioche waffle dough studded with Belgian pearl sugar that caramelizes into crunchy pockets.

items.name: Bread flour + instant yeast + 2 tbsp milk
Belgian pearl sugar (or crushed sugar cubes)

steps.title: Mix Rich Dough & Fold Pearl Sugar
steps.instructionTemplate: Knead {flour_bw} and {butter_bw} 5 mins, rest 30 mins, then gently knead in {pearl_bw} right before pressing.

steps.title: Press 4 Mins Until Caramelized
steps.instructionTemplate: Press portions in a hot waffle iron 4 minutes until deep amber caramelized pockets coat the outside.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 25 mins.

title: Saffron Pistachio Malai Kulfi Pops
hookLine: Dense, slow-creamed cardamom pistachio kulfi popsicles made in 10 mins with zero ice crystals.

items.name: Evaporated milk + condensed milk + heavy cream

steps.title: Whisk Milks, Pour into Molds & Freeze
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {milks_kf}, {spice_kf}, and {pist_kf} until frothy, pour into popsicle molds with wooden sticks, and freeze 5 hours until dense and creamy.
steps.creatorSecret: Condensed + evaporated milk prevents ice crystals completely without needing an ice cream maker.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 10 mins.

title: Æbleskiver
hookLine: Norway-inspired æbleskiver with 10 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Æbleskiver
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk the flour, salt, sugar, baking soda, and cardamom together in a large bowl. Separate the eggs and add the egg yolks to the flour mixture. Pour in the buttermilk (or cultured milk) and whisk the batter together until smooth. Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Æbleskiver
steps.instructionTemplate: Use a hand (or stand) mixer to beat the egg whites until stiff. Carefully fold into the æbleskiver batter. Heat the pan on medium heat. Once hot, brush the pan with butter and fill each æbleskive hole almost full with the batter.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Æbleskiver
steps.instructionTemplate: Once the edges become firm use a knitting needle or wooden skewer to turn the æbleskiver about 1/4. Continue turning until you get round pancake spheres. They should be golden brown. Remove the æbleskiver from the pan and serve with powdered sugar and jam.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!

title: Alfajores
hookLine: Argentina-inspired alfajores with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Make the Dough: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg yolks and lemon zest. Gradually mix in flour and cornstarch to form a dough. Chill for 1 hour.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure all purpose flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake the Cookies: Roll out the dough, cut into circles, and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 12-15 minutes. Let cool.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Assemble: Spread dulce de leche on one cookie, then sandwich with another. Roll the edges in coconut flakes.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Chill the dough before rolling it out to make it easier to handle and to prevent the cookies from spreading too much while baking.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Alfajores
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip the alfajores in melted chocolate and let them set on a wire rack for an extra decadent treat.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!

title: Anzac biscuits
hookLine: Australian-inspired anzac biscuits with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Anzac biscuits
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Put the oats, coconut, flour and sugar in a bowl. Melt the butter in a small pan and stir in the golden syrup. Add the bicarbonate of soda to 2 tbsp boiling water, then stir into the golden syrup and butter mixture.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure porridge oats first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Anzac biscuits
steps.instructionTemplate: Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and pour in the butter and golden syrup mixture. Stir gently to incorporate the dry ingredients.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Anzac

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Blackberry Fool
steps.instructionTemplate: For the biscuits, preheat the oven to 200C/180C (fan)/Gas 6 and line two large baking trays with baking parchment. Scatter the nuts over a baking tray and roast in the oven for 6-8 minutes, or until golden-brown. Watch them carefully so that they don’t have a chance to burn. Remove from the oven, tip onto a board and leave to cool. Put the butter and sugar in a large bowl and beat with a wooden spoon until light and creamy. Roughly chop the cooled nuts and add to the creamed butter and sugar, along with the lemon zest, flour and baking powder. Stir well until the mixture comes together and forms a ball – you may need to use your hands. Divide the biscuit dough into 24 even pieces and roll into small balls. Place the balls the prepared baking trays, spaced well apart to allow for spreading.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure hazlenuts first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Press the biscuits to flatten to around 1cm/½in thick. Bake the biscuits, one tray at a time, for 12 minutes or until very pale golden-brown. Leave to cool on the trays. They will be very soft when you take them out of the oven, but will crisp as they cool. Store in an airtight tin and eat within five days. For the fool, rinse the blackberries in a colander to wash away any dust or dirt. Put the blackberries in a non-stick saucepan and sprinkle over the caster sugar.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir in the lemon juice and heat gently for two minutes, or until the blackberries begin to soften and release their juices. Remove and reserve 12 blackberries for decoration and continue cooking the rest. Simmer the blackberries very gently for 15 minutes, stirring regularly until very soft and squidgy. Remove from the heat and press the berries and juice through a sieve over a bowl, using the bottom of a ladle to help you extract as much of the purée as possible. Leave the purée to cool and discard the seeds. You should end up with around 325ml/11fl oz of purée. Put the cream and yoghurt in a large bowl and whip with an electric whisk until soft peaks form when the whisk is removed from the bowl – the acidity of the fruit will thicken the cream further, so don’t take it too far.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Blackberry
steps.instructionTemplate: When the purée is completely cold, adjust the sweetness to taste by adding more sugar if needed. Pour it into the bowl with the whipped cream and yoghurt and stir just once or twice until very lightly combined. Spoon the blackberry fool into individual wide, glass dishes – or one large, single bowl. It should look quite marbled, so don’t over-stir it. Scatter a few tiny mint leaves on top and decorate with the reserved blackberries. Sprinkle with a little sugar if you like and serve with the hazelnut biscuits.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Chelsea Buns
steps.instructionTemplate: Sift the flour and salt into a large bowl. Make a well in the middle and add the yeast. Meanwhile, warm the milk and butter in a saucepan until the butter melts and the mixture is lukewarm. Add the milk mixture and egg to the flour mixture and stir until the contents of the bowl come together as a soft dough. (You may need to add a little extra flour.)
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure white flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Chelsea Buns
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip the dough onto a generously floured work surface. Knead for five minutes, adding more flour if necessary, until the dough is smooth and elastic and no longer feels sticky. Lightly oil a bowl with a little of the vegetable oil. Place the dough into the bowl and turn until it is covered in the oil. Cover the bowl with cling film and set aside in a warm place for one hour, or until the dough has doubled in size. Lightly grease a baking tray.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Chelsea Buns
steps.instructionTemplate: For the filling, knock the dough back to its original size and turn out onto a lightly floured work surface. Roll the dough out into a rectangle 0.5cm/¼in thick. Brush all over with the melted butter, then sprinkle over the brown sugar, cinnamon and dried fruit. Roll the dough up into a tight cylinder , cut ten 4cm/1½in slice and place them onto a lightly greased baking sheet, leaving a little space between each slice. Cover with a tea towel and set aside to rise for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 190C/375F/Gas 5.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Chelsea Buns
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake the buns in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until risen and golden-brown. Meanwhile, for the glaze, heat the milk and sugar in a saucepan until boiling. Reduce the heat and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Remove the buns from the oven and brush with the glaze, then set aside to cool on a wire rack.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

title: Chinon Apple Tarts
hookLine: France-inspired chinon apple tarts with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the red wine jelly, put the red wine, jam sugar, star anise, clove, cinnamon stick, allspice, split vanilla pod and seeds in a medium saucepan. Stir together, then heat gently to dissolve the sugar. Turn up the heat and boil for 20 mins until reduced and syrupy. Strain into a small, sterilised jam jar and leave to cool completely. Will keep in the fridge for up to 1 month.
steps.activeMeasureSummary: Puff Pastry, Dark Brown Soft Sugar
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure puff pastry first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Take the pastry out of the fridge and leave at room temperature for 10 mins, then unroll. Heat the grill to high and heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Cut out 2 x 13cm circles of pastry, using a plate as a guide, and place on a non-stick baking sheet. Sprinkle each circle with 1 tbsp sugar and grill for 5 mins to caramelise, watching carefully so that the sugar doesn’t burn. Remove from the grill. Can be done a few hours ahead, and left, covered, out of the fridge.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Peel, quarter and core the apples, cut into 2mm-thin slices and arrange on top of the pastry. Sprinkle over the remaining sugar and pop in the oven for 20-25 mins until the pastry is cooked through and golden, and the apples are softened. Remove and allow to cool slightly. Warm 3 tbsp of the red wine jelly in a small pan over a low heat with 1 tsp water to make it a little more runny, then brush over the top of the tarts.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Chinon
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip the crème fraîche into a bowl, sift over the icing sugar and cardamom, and mix together. Carefully lift the warm tarts onto serving plates and serve with the cardamom crème fraîche.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

title: Choc Chip Pecan Pie
hookLine: United States-inspired choc chip pecan pie with 12 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: First, make the pastry. Tip the ingredients into a food processor with 1 /4 tsp salt. Blend until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Drizzle 2-3 tsp cold water into the funnel while the blade is running – the mixture should start to clump together. Tip onto a work surface and bring together, kneading briefly into a ball. Pat into a disc, wrap in cling film, and chill for at least 20 mins. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove the pastry from the fridge and leave at room temperature for 5 mins to soften. Flour the work surface, then unwrap the pastry and roll to a circle the thickness of a £1 coin. Use the pastry to line a deep, 23cm round fluted tin – mine was about 3cm deep. Press the pastry into the corners and up the sides, making sure there are no gaps. Leave 1cm pastry overhanging (save some of the pastry scraps for later). Line with baking parchment (scrunch it up first to make it more pliable) and fill with baking beans. Blind-bake for 15-20 mins until the sides are set, then remove the parchment and beans and return to the oven for 5 mins until golden brown. Trim the pastry so it’s flush with the top of the tin – a small serrated knife is best for this. If there are any cracks, patch them up with the pastry scraps.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, weigh the butter, syrup and sugars into a pan, and add 1 /4 tsp salt. Heat until the butter has melted and the sugar dissolved, stirring until smooth. Remove from the heat and cool for 10 mins. Reduce oven to 160C/140C fan/gas 3.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Choc
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Add the syrup mixture, vanilla and pecans, and mix until well combined. Pour half the mixture into the tart case, scatter over half the chocolate chips, then cover with the remaining filling and chocolate chips. Bake on the middle shelf for 50-55 mins until set. Remove from the oven and leave to cool, then chill for at least 2 hrs before serving.
steps.activeMeasureSummary: Light Brown Soft Sugar, Dark Brown Soft Sugar

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: For the cookies cream the butter with the sugar for a few minutes. Then add the egg and honey and mix well. Add flour, cornstarch, cocoa, baking soda and baking powder and mix until you get a dough. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for at least half an hour or overnight.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper, preheat oven to 200 degrees Celsius.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Divide dough into two parts, put one part back in the fridge before using. Roll out second part to about 2 millimeters and cut out round cookies with 5-6 centimeters in diameter. This can be done with a cookie cutter or glass. You should get 30 cookies in total or even more, I get about 40. Bake one baking sheet at the time for about 8-10min. Let cookies cool.

steps.title: Build the Bake / Chill Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: For the filling look for two cookies of the same size and place about one teaspoon of dulce de leche onto the bottom one before sandwiching together.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Chocolate
steps.instructionTemplate: Chop semi-sweet chocolate and melt with butter and orange zest on low heat. Dunk each sandwich cookie into the chocolate and let cool off on parchment paper before serving.

steps.instructionTemplate: Blend all the mousse ingredients together in your food processor until smooth. title: Chocolate churros with chocolate & salted caramel sauce

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the sauce, tip the sugar and butter into a saucepan and bring to a simmer until the sugar has melted, then stir in the cream and simmer until you have a smooth sauce, about 2-3 mins. Remove from the heat, stir through a pinch of sea salt and the chocolate, and continue to stir for 2-3 mins, or until it has completely melted. Keep warm or leave to cool for reheating later. For the coating, mix the sugar with the cinnamon and a small pinch of fine sea salt and set aside.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure sunflower oil first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: For the churros, tip the flour, cocoa, baking powder and a large pinch of salt into a bowl. Add the vanilla extract and melted butter, then carefully pour in 250-300ml boiling water and whisk to make a smooth, very thick batter. Leave to cool for a few minutes, then scrape the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a medium star nozzle.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Chocolate
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip sunflower oil into a deep-fat fryer following the manufacturer’s instructions, or a heavy-based pan, ensuring it is no more than a third full. Heat to 170C, or until a cube of bread dropped in browns in 30 seconds. Pipe 12-15cm lengths of dough into the oil, snipping off the end of each one with a pair of scissors as you go. Pipe four or five at a time and cook for around 4 mins, or until golden and crisp, turning them with tongs or a slotted spoon as they cook. Remove from the oil and place on a wire rack. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Leave to cool if reheating later, otherwise roll the churros in the cinnamon sugar and serve immediately with the warm chocolate sauce and ice cream. To reheat the churros, put on a tray and bake for 5-8 mins, then roll in the sugar coating. Meanwhile, warm the sauce in a pan and serve alongside for dipping.

For further tips, please check here. For the dough combine the flour, cocoa powder, and salt in a large bowl. Add the cold butter in small pieces and rub into crumbs with your fingers Add the egg and work into a dough. You may have to add milk, a tablespoon at a time if it still is to dry. Wrap and chill for at least half an hour or overnight.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure condensed milk first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer

Brush the edges with milk, I do this with my pinkie. Fold each circle in half so that you have a half moon and press down the edges with a fork. You can also turn the edges about half a centimeter inwards every centimeter or so to create a pattern.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Chocolate
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the prepared empanadas on the baking sheet and brush with egg wash. Bake for about 20-25min. Towards the end of the baking time, melt the remaining butter and mix the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Once you take the empanadas out, immediately brush with the butter and sprinkle with the sugar mix. Empanadas can be enjoyed either still warm or cold. steps.title: Prep & Mix: Churros
steps.instructionTemplate: Boil the kettle, then measure 300ml boiling water into a jug and add the melted butter and vanilla extract. Sift the flour and baking powder into a big mixing bowl with a big pinch of salt. Make a well in the centre, then pour in the contents of the jug and very quickly beat into the flour with a wooden spoon until lump-free. Rest for 10-15 mins while you make the sauce. Put all the sauce ingredients into a pan and gently melt together, stirring occasionally until you have a smooth shiny sauce. Keep warm on a low heat.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Churros
steps.instructionTemplate: Fill a large deep saucepan one-third full of oil. Cooking with hot oil can be dangerous – before you start, read up on how to deep-fry safely to avoid accidents in the kitchen. Heat until a cube of bread browns in 45 seconds to 1 min. Cover a tray with kitchen paper and mix the caster sugar and cinnamon together. Fit a star nozzle to a piping bag – 1.5-2cm wide is a good size. Fill with the rested dough, then pipe 2-3 strips directly into the pan, snipping off each dough strip with a pair of kitchen scissors. Fry until golden brown and crisp. Be very careful here – if air bubbles form in the churros they can explode, especially if the oil overheats or you use old flour. Cooking with hot oil can be dangerous – before you start, read up on how to deep-fry safely to avoid accidents in the kitchen. Keep children out of the kitchen and protect yourself by wearing long sleeves and eye protection, and keeping your face away from the pan.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Churros
steps.instructionTemplate: Once the churros are crisp and golden brown, remove them from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on the kitchen paper-lined tray. Carry on cooking the rest of the dough in batches, sprinkling the cooked churros with some cinnamon sugar as you go. When you’ve cooked all the churros, toss with any remaining cinnamon sugar and serve with the chocolate sauce, for dipping. steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Prepare the almonds the day before. Bring 6 cups of water to a boil. Remove from heat, and add the almonds. Let the almonds soak in water for about 5 minutes, then drain and peel. Spread the almonds on baking sheets, and bake at 200 degrees F(95 degrees C) until completely dry and toasted. This takes several hours, and needs to be prepared ahead. Be careful not to burn the nuts, as this will give a bitter taste to the filling. Combine 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Add 1 teaspoon lemon juice, reduce heat to low, and let it simmer until syrupy, about 30 to 40 minutes. Stir in orange blossom water, and remove from heat. Set sugar syrup aside.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure sugar first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Combine flour and salt in a large mixing bowl. Gradually sprinkle with warm water while mixing until the dough becomes soft and pliable. Divide into 4 equal portions. Cover dough with a wet cloth, and set aside. In a food processor, finely grind the almonds. Measure 3 cups of the finely ground almonds into a mixing bowl, and stir together with 1 cup sugar, baking powder, vanilla powder, lemon zest, and 2 tablespoons orange flower water. Mix in three eggs one at a time, stirring constantly; mix until you get a sticky, paste-like mixture.

steps.title: Finish & Serve Dziriat
steps.instructionTemplate: Sprinkle cornstarch on the rolling surface to prevent sticking. Roll each portion of dough very thinly, 1 to 2 millimeters (1/16 inch). Cut the rolled dough into circles of about 10 centimeters (4 inches) in diameter each. Lightly wipe the surface of each circle with cornstarch, and fit into a tart mold, cornstarch side down to prevent sticking. Gently press the dough onto the sides and bottom of the mold, and trim extra dough from around the rim. Fill three quarters of each mold with the almond filling. Bake on the top shelf at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the surface of the tart is golden and the dough is firm. Remove the tarts from the molds as soon as they come out of the oven. Dip each tart in the sugar syrup while still hot. Stick a pine nut into the middle of each tart for decoration. Place on a wire rack to drain.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Ensaimada
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour 230ml lukewarm water into a bowl and add the yeast. Leave to stand for 3 mins, then add the caster sugar, eggs, flour and 1 tsp sea salt flakes. steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure yeast first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

(If you want to fill your pastry with sobrasada de Mallorca, mix 50g lard with the sobrasada, and spread this over the dough instead.) Pull one corner of the flattened dough and stretch it out as far as it will go without breaking. Repeat every 10cm or so around the dough rectangle in every direction until it reaches about 50 x 70cm.

steps.instructionTemplate: Cut a strip from each of the shorter sides and lay these beside each other along one of the longer sides of the rectangle; this is what we call the heart of the ensaimada. steps.instructionTemplate: Take the first roll of dough and stretch it until it is over a metre long. Then, roll it up into a spiral, leaving 1cm between each turn of the spiral so the dough can expand. Flatten a little and transfer to a baking sheet lined with baking parchment. Repeat with the remaining dough. Leave to rise in a warm place for at least 12 hrs, or ideally 24 hrs.

steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the ensaimadas in the top third of the oven and immediately reduce the temperature to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base

It should form ribbons as you drag the whisk though it Take a cast-iron korai or wok and add enough oil to half-fill the pan, or enough to deep-fry and turn the heat to high. Once the oil is hot reduce the heat to low–medium. Drop in a teaspoon of batter to test the oil – if it rises slowly to the surface the oil is ready

Carefully turn over and cook for a further 30–45 seconds, until golden. Make sure to not let excess batter drip into the pan as this may prevent the cakes from rising and always fry one at a time If the batter splits while frying, whisk in 2 tablespoons of flour to the mixture and try again. You should be creating handesh which are about the size of a digestive biscuit

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Line an 8-inch-square baking pan with wax paper or foil, and coat with non-stick spray. Microwave the dark chocolate mixture in 20-second intervals, stirring in between each interval, until the chocolate is melted. steps.title: Prep & Mix: Jam Roly-Poly
steps.instructionTemplate: Put a deep roasting tin onto the bottom shelf of the oven, and make sure that there’s another shelf directly above it. Pull the roasting tin out on its shelf, fill two-thirds with boiling water from the kettle, then carefully slide it back in. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Tear off a large sheet of foil and greaseproof paper (about 30 x 40cm). Sit the greaseproof on top of the foil and butter it.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Jam Roly-Poly
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip butter, flour and vanilla seeds into a food processor; pulse until the butter has disappeared. Tip into a mixing bowl. Stir through the suet, pour in the milk and work together with a cutlery knife until you get a sticky dough. You may need a drop more milk, depending on your flour.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Jam Roly-Poly
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip the dough out onto a floured surface, quickly pat together to smooth, then roll out to a square roughly 25 x 25cm. Spread the jam all over, leaving a gap along one edge, then roll up from the opposite edge. Pinch the jam-free edge into the dough where it meets, and pinch the ends roughly, too. Carefully lift onto the greased paper, join-side down (you might find a flat baking sheet helpful for this), loosely bring up the paper and foil around it, then scrunch together along the edges and ends to seal. The roly-poly will puff quite a bit during cooking so don’t wrap it tightly. Lift the parcel directly onto the rack above the tin and cook for 1 hr.

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base

Then return the saucepan to the heat and pour the egg mixture back into the saucepan with remaining milk, whisking constantly. Once the mixture thickens lower the heat and continue whisking for about 30 seconds. Pour the custard into a clean bowl and cover with plastic wrap, placing the plastic directly on the top layer of the custard. Chill in the fridge.

Cover a baking sheet with baking paper and spread out the batter into a large, even rectangle. Whisk together the egg whites and sugar until you get glossy, stiff peaks. The meringue should hold its form – if it still melts continue whisking. Spread out the meringue on top of the cake batter. Use a spatula to form light waves with the meringue. Sprinkle almonds on top of the meringue. Bake for about 30 minutes, until the meringue and almonds are golden.

Place half of the cake on a serving platter with the meringue side down and peel off the baking paper. Spread the cream filling across the cake. steps.title: Prep & Mix: Postre Chajá
steps.instructionTemplate: For the sponge cake preheat oven to 180 degrees Celsius and prepare either one or two 20cm/8 inch cake pan(s). Line bottom with parchment paper. Then divide the eggs into egg white and egg yolks. Use a bigger bowl for the egg yolks. If you have a glass or metal bowl, use that one for the egg whites. Be sure that bowl is free of fat/grease and that your mixer was properly cleaned. First beat the egg whites on medium speed with a pinch of salt until soft peaks form. Set aside. Without cleaning our mixer, beat the egg yolks with the sugar. Beat until the color becomes much paler and you have a creamy consistency. This usually takes several minutes.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure egg first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Postre Chajá
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently pour one third of the egg whites on top of the mixed egg yolks and sift the flour and cornstarch on top. Don't skip this step. It is important that the flour mix was sifted. Gently mix all ingredients with a spatula. Try to incorperate the flour mix and egg whites without losing volume. Add the last two thirds of beaten egg whites and gently fold the mixture. Don't overmix. Put batter into the prepared cake pans and immediately bake. Don't let the batter sit for too long as it will quickly lose volume. Bake for 35 minutes if using one springform or 25 minutes if using two. Let cool a little before gently getting them out of the form. Tip: if making the day before, wrap in cling wrap, it is much easier to cut in half once cold.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Postre Chajá
steps.instructionTemplate: For the meringue beat egg white until soft peaks form, add pinch of salt and continue beating on high while adding the sugar. Beat for at least three more minutes until glossy and shiny. Pipe small stars or other shapes with the meringue on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Dry for about 45min at 100 degrees Celsius in the oven. Keep in airtight container until further use.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Postre Chajá
steps.instructionTemplate: For the filling beat heavy cream, vanilla extract and sugar until stiff peaks form, slice peaches in thin slices. Cut cake in four layers, this is much easier done once the cake layers are cold. Brush cake layer with some of the peach juice left, then pipe thin layer of whipped cream around the edges, place the peach slices in the middle on first layer on cake, on the second layer only spread the dulce de leche. Repeat layer with brushed peach juice, whipped cream and peaches for the third and final layer. Be sure to reserve enough peach slices for the top. Spread thin layer of whipped cream on the sides of the cake and pipe on some roses around the edges if desired. Heat the peach juice and mix the cornstarch with a bit of water until you see no lumps. Once juice is hot, add the cornstarch and stir until glaze thickenes. Pour over peaches of the top layer cake. Crush the meringue and pat around the sides. Serve immediately.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Saskatoon Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the pastry, place the flour and salt in a large bowl. Mix well. Add the cubes of butter and shortening and mix them in (I like to use my hands to mix the fat into the flour, but you can use a pastry blender) just until it looks like coarse oatmeal with some pea-sized bits remaining. Place the egg in a 2-cup measure and beat it with a fork. Beat in the vinegar and just enough ice-cold water to bring it to the 1-cup mark. Stir this into the flour mixture, just until the dough clings together. I like to use my hands for this part as well, but a wooden spoon would also work. Try not to overmix it. On a lightly floured surface, gather the dough into a ball and divide it into 5 evenly sized portions. Shape each portion into a disc and wrap tightly in plastic. Chill 2 of these discs for 1 hour. Freeze the other 3 in a resealable freezer bag for future use. The pastry keeps well in the freezer for up to 2 months.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Saskatoon Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the filling, place the saskatoon berries in a large bowl and stir in the 1/2 cup sugar and the cornstarch until well combined. Pour the berry mixture into the bottom of the pie. Dot with the butter. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pastry in another 12-inch circle for the top crust. Use a ruler to guide you when cutting the pastry into 6 wide, long strips to keep the edges straight. Save the 2 end pieces in case you need to do any patching. I like wide strips, but if you like a thinner look, feel free to cut thin strips of pastry. Weave the pastry strips, going over and under, making sure they connect with the edges of the pie crust. Fold over the edges of the bottom crust, tucking in the lattice ends. This will help to trap the juices and give a rustic look. If you prefer a cleaner, tidier look, you can trim the overhanging pieces and crimp the edges with a fork. Brush the top of the pie with the egg wash. Sprinkle with the remaining Tbsp sugar. Place the pie on the prepared baking sheet and bake it for about 90 – 100 minutes, until it’s golden brown and bubbling. Remove the pie from the oven and place it on a wire rack to cool.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Saskatoon Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Serve the pie warm or at room temperature with whipped cream or ice cream. Makes 6 servings. This keeps well if covered with plastic and refrigerated for up to 4 days.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: While the dates are soaking, make the puddings. Mix the flour and bicarbonate of soda together and beat the eggs in a separate bowl. Beat the butter and sugar together in a large bowl for a few mins until slightly creamy (the mixture will be grainy from the sugar). Add the eggs a little at a time, beating well between additions. Beat in the black treacle then, using a large metal spoon, gently fold in one-third of the flour, then half the milk, being careful not to overbeat. Repeat until all the flour and milk is used. Stir the soaked dates into the pudding batter. The mix may look a little curdled at this point and will be like a soft, thick batter. Spoon it evenly between the tins and bake for 20-25 mins, until risen and firm.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Meanwhile, put the sugar and butter for the sauce in a medium saucepan with half the cream. Bring to the boil over a medium heat, stirring all the time, until the sugar has completely dissolved. Stir in the black treacle, turn up the heat slightly and let the mixture bubble away for 2-3 mins until it is a rich toffee colour, stirring occasionally to make sure it doesn’t burn. Take the pan off the heat and beat in the rest of the cream.

You can serve them now with the sauce drizzled over, but they’ll be even stickier if left for a day or two coated in the sauce. To do this, pour about half the sauce into one or two ovenproof serving dishes. Sit the upturned puddings on the sauce, then pour the rest of the sauce over them. Cover with a loose tent of foil so that the sauce doesn’t smudge (no need to chill).

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Pie Crust:  In a food processor, place the flour, salt, and sugar and process until combined. Add the butter and process until the mixture resembles coarse meal (about 15 seconds). Pour 1/4 cup (60 ml) water in a slow, steady stream, through the feed tube until the dough just holds together when pinched. If necessary, add more water. Do not process more than 30 seconds. Turn the dough onto your work surface and gather into a ball. Divide the dough in half, flattening each half into a disk, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for about one hour before using. This will chill the butter and relax the gluten in the flour.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: After the dough has chilled sufficiently, remove one portion of the dough from the fridge and place it on a lightly floured surface.  Roll the pastry into a 12 inch (30 cm) circle. (To prevent the pastry from sticking to the counter and to ensure uniform thickness, keep lifting up and turning the pastry a quarter turn as you roll (always roll from the center of the pastry outwards).)  Fold the dough in half and gently transfer to a 9 inch (23 cm) pie pan. Brush off any excess flour and trim any overhanging pastry to an edge of 1/2 inch (1.5 cm). Refrigerate the pastry, covered with plastic wrap, while you make the filling. Remove the second round of pastry and roll it into a 13 inch (30 cm) circle. Using a pastry wheel or pizza cutter, cut the pastry into about 3/4 inch (2 cm) strips. Place the strips of pastry on a parchment paper-lined baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and place in the refrigerator for about 10 minutes. Make the Strawberry Rhubarb Filling: Place the cut strawberries and rhubarb in a large bowl. In a small bowl mix together the cornstarch, sugar, and ground cinnamon.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove the chilled pie crust from the fridge. Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of the sugar mixture over the bottom of the pastry crust. Add the remaining sugar mixture to the strawberries and rhubarb and gently toss to combine. Pour the fruit mixture into the prepared pie shell. Sprinkle the fruit with about 1 teaspoon of lemon juice and dot with 2 tablespoons of butter. Remove the lattice pastry from the refrigerator and, starting at the center with the longest strips and working outwards, place half the strips, spacing about 1 inch (2.5 cm) apart, on top of the filling. (Use the shortest pastry strips at the outer edges.) Then, gently fold back, about halfway, every other strip of pastry. Take another strip of pastry and place it perpendicular on top of the first strips of pastry. Unfold the bottom strips of pastry and then fold back the strips that weren't folded back the first time. Lay another strip of pastry perpendicular on top of the filling and then continue with the remaining strips. Trim the edges of the pastry strips, leaving a 1 inch (2.5 cm) overhang. Seal the edges of the pastry strips by folding them under the bottom pastry crust and flute the edges of the pastry. Brush the lattice pastry with milk and sprinkle with a little sugar. Cover and place in the refrigerator while you preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C) and place the oven rack in the lower third of the oven. Put a baking sheet, lined with aluminum foil, on the oven rack (to catch any spills.) Place the pie plate on the hot baking sheet and bake the pie for about 35 minutes and then, if the edges of the pie are browning too much, cover with a foil ring. Continue to bake the pie for about another 10 minutes or until the crust is a golden brown color and the fruit juices begin to bubble.

Cut the crusts off the bread. Cut 4 pieces of bread in half, a little on an angle, to give 2 lopsided rectangles per piece. Cut 2 slices into 4 triangles each and leave the final piece whole.

steps.title: Build the Shape & Layer Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Build the pud: Dip the whole piece of bread into the juice for a few secs just to coat. Push this into the bottom of the basin. Now dip the wonky rectangular pieces one at a time and press around the basin’s sides so that they fit together neatly, alternately placing wide and narrow ends up. If you can’t quite fit the last piece of bread in it doesn’t matter, just trim into a triangle, dip in juice and slot in. Now spoon in the softened fruit, adding the strawberries here and there as you go.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Summer Pudding
steps.instructionTemplate: Let flavours mingle then serve: Dip the bread triangles in juice and place on top – trim off overhang with scissors. Keep leftover juice for later. Bring cling film up and loosely seal. Put a side plate on top and weight down with cans. Chill for 6 hrs or overnight. To serve, open out cling film then put a serving plate upside-down on top and flip over. serve with leftover juice, any extra berries and cream.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Tamal De Maicena
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven at 350F. In a non-stick medium pot, add the milk, butter, sugar, and vanilla; bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low.

steps.title: Build the Build Flavor Layer

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll the pastry to a 3mm-thick round on a lightly floured surface and cut a 24cm circle, using a plate as a guide. Lightly prick all over with a fork, wrap in cling film on a baking sheet and freeze while preparing the apples.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Peel, quarter and core the apples. Put the sugar in a flameproof 20cm ceramic Tatin dish or a 20cm ovenproof heavy-based frying pan and place over a medium-high heat. Cook the sugar for 5-7 mins to a dark amber caramel syrup that’s starting to smoke, then turn off the heat and stir in the 60g diced chilled butter.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: To assemble the Tarte Tatin, arrange the apple quarters very tightly in a circle around the edge of the dish first, rounded-side down, then fill in the middle in a similar fashion. Gently press with your hands to ensure there are no gaps. Brush the fruit with the melted butter.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in the oven for 30 mins, then remove and place the disc of frozen puff pastry on top – it will quickly defrost. Tuck the edges down the inside of the dish and, with a knife, prick a few holes in the pastry to allow steam to escape. Bake for a further 40-45 mins until the pastry is golden brown and crisp.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Allow to cool to room temperature for 1 hr before running a knife around the edge of the dish and inverting it onto a large serving plate that is deep enough to contain the juices. Serve with crème fraîche or vanilla ice cream.

steps.title: Mix the Prep & Mix Base
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the oven to 180°C. For the dough, mix flour and sugar in a bowl. Heat the 100 grams of milk to lukewarm and dissolve the yeast in it. Let stand for a while until it starts to bubble. Then add to the flour along with the coconut oil and mix into a smooth dough. Let rise for 30 minutes, covered, in a warm place.

title: Treacle Tart
hookLine: British-inspired treacle tart with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Treacle Tart
steps.instructionTemplate: First make the short crust pastry: measure the flour into a large bowl and rub in the butter with your fingertips until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs (alternatively, this can be done in a food processor). Add about three tablespoons of cold water and mix to a firm dough, wrap in cling film and chill in the fridge for about 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200C/400F/Gas 6 and put a heavy baking tray in the oven to heat up. Grease a deep 18cm/7in loose-bottomed fluted flan tin with butter. Remove about 150g/5½oz of pastry from the main ball and set aside for the lattice top. Roll the rest of the pastry out thinly on a lightly floured work surface and line the prepared flan tin with the pastry.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Treacle Tart
steps.instructionTemplate: Prick the base with a fork, to stop the base rising up during baking. Place the reserved pastry for the lattice top on cling film and roll out thinly. Egg wash the pastry and set aside to chill in the fridge (the cling film makes it easier to move about). Do not cut into strips at this stage. Do not egg wash the strips once they are on the tart as it will drip into the treacle mixture. To make the filling, heat the syrup gently in a large pan but do not boil. Once melted, add the breadcrumbs, lemon juice and zest to the syrup. (You can add less lemon if you would prefer less citrus taste.) If the mixture looks runny, add a few more breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Treacle Tart
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the syrup mixture into the lined tin and level the surface. Remove the reserved pastry from the fridge and cut into long strips, 1cm/½in wide. Make sure they are all longer than the edges of the tart tin. Egg wash the edge of the pastry in the tin, and start to make the woven laying lattice pattern over the mixture, leave the strips hanging over the edge of the tin. Once the lattice is in place, use the tin edge to cut off the strips by pressing down with your hands, creating a neat finish.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Treacle Tart
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake on the pre-heated baking tray in the hot oven for about 10 minutes until the pastry has started to colour, and then reduce the oven temperature to 180C/350F/Gas 4. If at this stage the lattice seems to be getting too dark brown, cover the tart with tin foil. Bake for a further 25-30 minutes until the pastry is golden-brown and the filling set. Remove the tart from the oven and leave to firm up in the tin. Serve warm or cold.
